description: This file defines data structures and functions related to scope management, call stacks, and module information within the Torch JIT compiler, including Scope, ModuleInstanceInfo, and InlinedCallStack.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Represents a nested scope node in a trie structure used for managing nested execution scopes in Torch JIT.

classes.name: ModuleInstanceInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a module's type and instance name, used for callstack tracking.

classes.name: InlinedCallStack
classes.description: Represents a callstack element for inlined functions, including source range, function info, and optional module instance info.

methods.name: Scope::push
methods.description: Creates a new scope with the given name as a child of the current scope.

methods.name: Scope::isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the scope is the root scope.

methods.name: Scope::name
methods.description: Returns the name of the scope.

methods.name: ModuleInstanceInfo::class_type
methods.description: Returns the class type pointer of the module.

methods.name: ModuleInstanceInfo::instance_name
methods.description: Returns the instance name of the module.

methods.name: InlinedCallStack::vec
methods.description: Returns the callstack as a vector of function and source range pairs.
